gen-megrim-gf-slabo-13px: Megrim draws angular, futuristic letters in hairline strokes with a bent-paperclip c, and Slabo 13px follows in a classic serif that feels bookish. Sharp against dignified.
gen-megrim-gf-suwannaphum: Angular and futuristic, Megrim keeps its strokes at a single hairline thickness. Meanwhile Suwannaphum, a classic serif, stands tall and editorial, its x-height reaching high like a squared-off woodblock letter.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab reads as a dignified serif, its rounded lowercase tall and its c gaping wide at any size. And Mystery Quest sits above it with nostalgic, bookish curves, each one left open at the jaw.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-fauna-one: Open jaws on every curved stroke give Mystery Quest its nostalgic, bookish look. And Fauna One, a classic serif with a tall middle band, adds a literary dignity beneath it.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-glegoo: Nostalgic curves with gaping jaws up top, then a tall, big-countered lowercase underneath in Glegoo. Mystery Quest does the showing off, so give the text serif body a comfortable size.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-hanuman: Nostalgic in its open-jawed curves, Mystery Quest hands off to Hanuman, a text serif with a high-waisted lowercase. And a long page of it would feel traditional and refined, with wide-set terminals on the s.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-piazzolla: Refined is the first word for Piazzolla, whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals and whose e opens like a pried clasp. But Mystery Quest earns its keep large and short, where those open jaws can be seen.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-pridi: Classic and refined, Pridi gives its curves generous space against the stem, with small letters standing almost capital-sized. Mystery Quest can take the larger size, with Pridi a step down.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-scope-one: Open jaws on every curved stroke make Mystery Quest instantly nostalgic and bookish. But Scope One, a classic serif with stubby ascenders and a big x-height, lets its counters spill into the space around them.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-slabo-13px: Mystery Quest brings bookish, nostalgic curves with open jaws. Slabo 13px keeps a long page dignified, with large open counters in its tall a, e and s making each line easy going.
